wins: Maintained consistent logging and mentor engagement across all 10 calls, ensuring telemetry availability for further analysis
Held steady reward (40.00) during the lone episode, indicating stable behavior under current policy despite lack of success
fails: Failed to escalate privileges after initial presence, likely due to insufficient exploitation of exposed SSH service (ep001_step18)
Repeated service disruptions from defensive countermeasures prevented persistence, ending the run without success
key_outcomes.summary: The agent demonstrated disciplined procedure adherence and data gathering, but never converted reconnaissance into a successful breach due to recurring privilege escalation blocks.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent repeatedly attempted password-based SSH login without prior user enumeration, leading to lockouts at least five times in the same episode

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: If brute-force attempts trigger banner changes or immediate disconnect
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to user discovery and focus on valid credentials before reattempting login

skill_cards.if_condition: Upon successful enumeration of SSH with valid accounts
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate privilege escalation starting with sudo -l and fallback to known exploits

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Consistent pattern of lockouts suggests need for improved enumeration strategy
